title: Tensor Factory
name: create_tensor
contract: Copy input into a new CPU tensor; dtype=None uses Torch inference. No alias to source storage.
hint: Compare tensor construction with as_tensor; validate dtype in tests.

title: Shape Transformation
name: transform_tensor
contract: Reshape, allowing one inferred -1; support non-contiguous inputs.
grad: preserve autograd connection for floating input
hint: Think about when view requires contiguous memory.

title: Add Batch Dimension
name: add_batch_dim
contract: Insert one singleton axis, including negative dimensions; do not remove existing axes.
hint: Read the legal range of unsqueeze dimensions.

title: Last Dimension Normalization
name: normalize_last_dim
contract: Normalize each last-axis row with population std (correction=0), dividing by std clamped below by eps. Constants become zeros; eps>0.
hint: Keep reduced axes for broadcasting; explain singleton std.

title: Masked Row Selection
name: select_rows
contract: Select rows using a bool [N] mask; preserve row order.
hint: Check mask length and dtype; M may be zero.

title: Pairwise Cosine Similarity
name: pairwise_cosine_similarity
contract: Return all pairwise cosines; zero-norm vectors have similarity zero using norm clamp 1e-8.
hint: Sketch matrix multiplication axes before coding.

title: Recursive Device Transfer
name: move_to_device
contract: Transfer tensors recursively in dict/list/tuple; keep structure, keys and non-tensor leaves. Do not mutate input containers.
grad: Tensor.to preserves graph; CPU->CPU may return same tensor
hint: Use type checks; strings must not be treated as sequences.

title: NumPy Interoperability
name: to_numpy
contract: Return detached independent CPU NumPy copy. bfloat16 converts to float32; other NumPy-compatible dtypes preserved.
grad: explicitly detach; returned array has no graph
hint: Explain why direct numpy fails on requires_grad=True or CUDA.

title: Scalar Gradient
name: compute_scalar_gradient
contract: Differentiate f(x)=x^3+2*x^2+3*x for a scalar floating tensor; return detached derivative without modifying caller x.grad.
grad: construct fresh leaf, backward then detach result
hint: On paper: derivative of each power, then add. Avoid wrapping an existing graph accidentally.

title: Vector Gradient
name: compute_vector_gradient
contract: Differentiate scalar f(x)=sum(x*x+3*x); return detached gradient, do not modify caller x.grad.
hint: Each coordinate contributes independently; explain the chain rule through sum.

title: Gradient Accumulation
name: gradient_accumulation_demo
contract: For fresh scalar leaf and f=x^2, return detached copies: first gradient after one backward, accumulated after second fresh graph backward, after_zero after clearing grad and one more backward. Keys first/accumulated/after_zero.
grad: fresh graph per backward; snapshots must not alias .grad
hint: Track addition into .grad, then explain why clearing it changes the third result.

title: Detach Tensor
name: detach_tensor
contract: Return detached tensor sharing storage, not a clone. Explain contrast with no_grad context for future operations.
hint: Detach affects this tensor; no_grad affects operations in its context.

title: Freeze Parameters
name: freeze_parameters
contract: Freeze all parameters in-place and return model; do not change train/eval mode. Input gradients can still exist.
grad: parameter grads disabled; graph through differentiable inputs may remain
hint: requires_grad and eval control different behavior; explain BatchNorm/dropout.

title: Build MLP
name: build_mlp
contract: Return Linear/ReLU MLP, final Linear logits, no final Softmax; [] permits linear classifier. Positive dimensions.
hint: List layer dimensions first; CrossEntropyLoss expects logits.

title: Count Parameters
name: count_parameters
contract: Count ALL parameter elements, including frozen parameters.
hint: Buffers are not parameters; specify whether frozen parameters count.

title: One Training Epoch
name: train_one_epoch
contract: Train one epoch with mean-reduced classification loss; zero/backward/step per batch. Return sample-weighted loss, accuracy, samples. Empty loader raises ValueError.
dtype: float inputs, long targets; Python stats
grad: training gradients enabled; no graph in returned stats
hint: Set train mode, transfer both tensors; last batch may be smaller.

title: Model Evaluation
name: evaluate
contract: Evaluate mean-loss classification without any gradients; sample-weighted loss/accuracy/samples, restore previous mode; empty loader raises ValueError.
grad: no_grad/inference_mode; no parameter or grad mutation
hint: eval does not disable autograd by itself; multiply mean loss by batch size.

title: Probability Prediction
name: predict_proba
contract: Return concatenated CPU softmax probabilities in loader order, restore mode. Loader yields (inputs, targets); empty raises ValueError.
hint: Apply softmax over classes, not batch; detach before moving outputs.

title: Custom Dataset
name: CustomDataset
contract: Implement len/getitem and optional input transform; validate equal lengths.
grad: dataset does not detach tensor inputs
hint: Check labels remain paired after transform.

title: Dataset Split
name: split_indices
contract: Return (train,val) disjoint shuffled indices, floor(size*val_ratio) validation; size>=0, ratio in [0,1). Do not alter global RNG.
hint: Use a local generator and test that seed changes ordering.

title: Class Weights
name: compute_class_weights
contract: Inverse frequency N/(K*count); absent classes have zero weight; empty labels return zeros. Valid labels [0,K).
hint: Count missing classes without dividing by zero.

title: Padding Collate
name: pad_collate
contract: Right-pad 1D sequences with zero. Return inputs,lengths,targets. Empty sequences allowed; empty batch raises ValueError.
grad: padding should preserve paths if input needs gradients
hint: Separate sequence lengths from padding value.

title: Image Manifest
name: build_image_manifest
contract: Sorted immediate class directories (including empty) define labels. Recursively list png/jpg/jpeg/bmp files, case-insensitive, sorted relative paths; no image decoding. Return path(relative str),label,class_name.
hint: File suffix is not proof of image validity; projects check corruption separately.

title: DataLoader Factory
name: build_dataloader
contract: Create CPU loader, retain final short batch; batch_size>0, num_workers>=0. pin_memory=False for this CPU contract.
hint: shuffle training only; understand worker subprocesses vs batches.

title: Conv Output Size
name: conv2d_output_size
contract: One spatial axis, floor((I+2P-D*(K-1)-1)/S+1); positive I/K/S/D, P>=0 and output>=1.
shape: scalar I -> scalar O, apply separately to H/W
hint: Derive effective kernel size with dilation.

title: Build CNN
name: build_cnn
contract: At least two Conv/ReLU blocks and pooling, adaptive final pooling to support varying sizes; output logits.
hint: Avoid a Linear input size tied to 28x28.

title: Residual Block
name: build_residual_block
contract: Return same-shape block with output ReLU(x+F(x)); F contains two padded 3x3 convolutions and ReLU between them. No normalization required.
grad: both skip and residual preserve gradient
hint: Use out-of-place addition; test F=0 and negative x.

title: Top K Accuracy
name: topk_accuracy
contract: Fraction of samples whose label is among top k; require N>0 and 1<=k<=K.
hint: Top-k along class axis, not batch axis.

title: Freeze Backbone
name: freeze_backbone
contract: ResNet-style model: freeze every parameter except fc; fc remains trainable; return same model. Mode unchanged.
hint: Frozen parameters and frozen BatchNorm running stats are distinct.

title: Unfreeze Last Blocks
name: unfreeze_last_n_blocks
contract: Reset backbone frozen; unfreeze last n of layer1..layer4, n in [0,4]; fc trainable, stem stays frozen. Return model.
grad: last n stages and head track parameter grads
hint: n=0 must not accidentally select all via [-0:].

title: Replace Classifier
name: replace_classifier
contract: Replace ResNet fc with trainable Linear(old in_features,K), keep device/dtype and other parameters.
hint: Do not hard-code feature width; no network request.

title: Build Image Transforms
name: build_transforms
contract: PIL RGB conversion; training random resized crop/flip, evaluation deterministic resize; ToTensor and ImageNet mean/std.
grad: input transform has no autograd graph
hint: Train/val must not share random augmentation; ImageNet weights expect matching normalization.

title: Predict Batch
name: predict_batch
contract: Return CPU softmax probabilities, no gradients; preserve previous train/eval mode.
hint: eval alone does not disable gradients.

title: Set Random Seed
name: seed_everything
contract: Seed Python random, NumPy and Torch (and CUDA if available); same-environment reproducibility, not across platforms.
hint: Seed all RNGs; distinguish deterministic algorithms from seeds.

title: Experiment Config
name: validate_config
contract: Minimal flat exercise config: required epochs,batch_size positive integers (not bool),learning_rate finite positive; defaults seed=42/device=cpu, supported device cpu/cuda/mps/auto. Return new dict; invalid raises ValueError.
hint: Read YAML with safe_load outside this function; reject nan and strings as numeric values.

title: Average Meter
name: AverageMeter
contract: Maintain sum,count,avg; update(value,n=1) is sample-weighted; n>=0; reset all to zero.
hint: The last batch may be shorter.

title: Early Stopping
name: EarlyStopping
contract: Minimize loss; patience>=1,min_delta>=0; update(loss)->bool after patience consecutive non-improvements. Strict loss < best-min_delta counts as improvement.
hint: Reset bad-epoch counter on improvement; loss must be finite.

title: Gradient Clipping
name: clip_gradients
contract: Clip parameter gradient L2 norm in-place; return total norm before clipping; max_norm>0.
grad: no new graph; operates after backward
hint: Clip gradients, not parameter values; AMP needs unscale first.

title: Optimizer Factory
name: build_optimizer
contract: config name adam/sgd and positive lr; optional momentum for SGD; include only requires_grad parameters; unknown name raises ValueError.
grad: optimizer step changes parameters, not forward graph
hint: Frozen parameters must not be optimized.

title: Scheduler Factory
name: build_scheduler
contract: name step/plateau/none; step_size/gamma for StepLR, factor/patience for ReduceLROnPlateau. none returns None. Unknown raises ValueError.
hint: Step after optimizer update; plateau expects validation metric.

title: Save Checkpoint
name: save_checkpoint
contract: Save model/optimizer/scheduler state_dicts, epoch and best_metric. Never serialize entire model. Create parent directory.
hint: Keep schema keys explicit; scheduler may be None.

title: Load Checkpoint
name: load_checkpoint
contract: torch.load with explicit weights_only=True/map_location; restore supplied objects and return loaded metadata. Do not load arbitrary pickled modules.
hint: state_dict restores parameters; restoring optimizer/scheduler is separate.

title: JSONL Experiment Logger
name: log_experiment
contract: Append exactly one UTF-8 JSON object and newline, preserve existing records, reject non-finite JSON floats.
grad: convert values beforehand; no graph storage
hint: Serialize before appending so invalid records do not partially corrupt a log.
